description: Defines data models and structures for importing various entities such as teams, channels, users, posts, reactions, and roles in Mattermost. Includes data types for import data, version info, and related entities.

classes.name: LineImportData
classes.description: Main data model for importing various entities, including roles, schemes, teams, channels, users, bots, posts, direct channels, emojis, version info, and additional info.

classes.name: VersionInfoImportData
classes.description: Contains metadata about the import, such as generator, version, creation date, and additional raw data.

classes.name: TeamImportData
classes.description: Represents data for importing a team, including name, display name, type, description, invite permissions, and scheme.

classes.name: ChannelImportData
classes.description: Represents data for importing a channel, including associated team, name, display name, type, header, purpose, scheme, and deletion timestamp.

classes.name: Avatar
classes.description: Contains avatar image data for users and bots, including profile image URL and raw image data.

classes.name: UserImportData
classes.description: Represents data for importing a user, including avatar, username, email, auth info, personal details, roles, preferences, team memberships, and custom status.

classes.name: BotImportData
classes.description: Represents data for importing a bot, including avatar, username, owner, display name, description, and deletion timestamp.

classes.name: UserNotifyPropsImportData
classes.description: Notification preferences for a user per channel, including desktop, mobile, email, and mention triggers.

classes.name: UserTeamImportData
classes.description: Data for importing user team memberships, including team name, roles, theme, and channels.

classes.name: UserChannelImportData
classes.description: Data for importing user channel memberships, including roles, notification props, message counts, last viewed timestamp, and favorites.

classes.name: DirectChannelMemberImportData
classes.description: Data for members of direct message channels, including username, notification props, scheme roles, message counts, and last viewed timestamp.

classes.name: UserChannelNotifyPropsImportData
classes.description: Notification preferences for user channels, including desktop, mobile, unread, email, and mention settings.

classes.name: EmojiImportData
classes.description: Data for importing emojis, including name, image URL, and raw image data.

classes.name: ReactionImportData
classes.description: Data for reactions on posts or replies, including user, creation timestamp, and emoji name.

classes.name: ReplyImportData
classes.description: Data for reply messages, including user, type, message, properties, timestamps, flagged users, reactions, attachments, and pinned status.

classes.name: PostImportData
classes.description: Data for posts, including team, channel, user, message, properties, timestamps, reactions, replies, attachments, pinned status, and thread followers.

classes.name: DirectChannelImportData
classes.description: Data for direct message channels, including members, participants, favorited and shown users, and header.

classes.name: DirectPostImportData
classes.description: Data for direct message posts, including channel members, user, message, properties, timestamps, reactions, attachments, pinned status, and thread followers.

classes.name: SchemeImportData
classes.description: Data for importing permission schemes, including name, display name, description, scope, and default roles.

classes.name: RoleImportData
classes.description: Data for importing roles, including name, display name, description, permissions, and scheme management flag.

classes.name: LineImportWorkerData
classes.description: Extends LineImportData with line number for import processing.

classes.name: LineImportWorkerError
classes.description: Error information during import, including error details and line number.

classes.name: AttachmentImportData
classes.description: Data for attachments, including file path and raw zip file data.

classes.name: ComparablePreference
classes.description: Structure for comparing preferences by category and name.

classes.name: ThreadFollowerImportData
classes.description: Data for tracking thread followers, including username, last viewed timestamp, and unread mentions.
